data.name: Silent Ward: Forever Lost
data.detailed_description:
This is a horror thriller game.

Game Features: Utilizing new technologies from Unreal Engine 5, such as the Lumen system, enables realistic reflections on object surfaces. Nanite technology is employed to achieve high-fidelity models. To accommodate hardware performance concerns, if your hardware is outdated, the game supports disabling the Lumen system to use traditional baked lighting, as well as disabling Nanite to use traditional LOD.

Realistic physical feedback: When players discard items, they interact with the ground through elastic force.

The game employs a fully immersive first-person perspective that simulates human vision, allowing players to see their character's body for heightened realism. The game delivers software-based ray tracing, enabling users to experience ray tracing effects without requiring a dedicated ray-tracing GPU.
Unique interactive 3D UI: The game's user interface employs 3D design, significantly enhancing spatial depth perception.

data.short_description: The game is built using Unreal Engine 5 with an interactive 3D UI. Players must explore the ward and repair damaged circuits while evading the harassment of the Listener. Along the way, they must locate notes left by other survivors. With the help of the item information, they can leave.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Danish, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Vietnamese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win11
  • Processor: i5-3570K 3.4 GHz 4 Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12

  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for multiplayer. SSD required.
